Nature is healing.

This is by no means a shill of either coin, just the happy realization that sprouts of positive change might be happening on Solana.

Those where the two most obvious and hyped “launches” of the last couple of days, they both got created first on Stonks, ran hard, and then got vamped minutes later by pump. Massive band for band toxicity ensued, and eventually and inevitably the result was 90% crashes on both. 

Now, not only are they seeing some life again, but the stonks one has been “established” as the one in both cases. As it should be. That’s a big deal.

Vamping is a plague: I’m not sure how or if a coordinated solve is even possible, although Long eco is doing some great stuff in that sense. 

But if at the very least, as mamy championed today, you’d stop buying Pump’s nonsense and stick to Stonk’s launches, especially when clearly first, it’d be a very very good start. 

Maybe we can see some proper runners again instead of the usual extraction.

I’m proud of you manlets. 

Money talks.

- Oil continues to be strong af in the face of iran conflict, hard to see sustained bids if this continues

By end of this week should have a lot clearer view on a lot of the above and trend continuation or chop/reversal should be fairly obvious once the noise of headline moves is gone

Mainly going to be focusing on the clarity act alts and then the privacy/inference sector (longer term) for positioning
